relationship_to_formal_matrix_v1: separate binding-resource extension; not a retry, replacement, or relabelling

binding_resource.source: first qualifying candidate selected by the committed outcome-blind Protocol V3 sweep
binding_resource.batch_trace_rule: For decision window w, use the 16 matched-trace entries at positions (16*w+j) mod 600 for j=0..15 in the frozen per-seed trace order.
binding_resource.trace_multiplicity: Each of the 600 frozen matched-trace entries is evaluated exactly 16 times per run.
binding_resource.risk_aggregation: arithmetic mean of the 16 per-record frozen risk-proxy scores before policy selection
binding_resource.label_boundary: labels remain separate and are accessed only after action selection and detector inference
binding_resource.outcome_aggregation: tp, fp, tn, and fn are integer counts across the 16 records in the decision window

policy_logic.Safe-Greedy: Using the exact V2 guard shared with FSSQL-R, maximize the unchanged frozen immediate reward over A_safe; use the frozen FISVDD fallback only if empty.
policy_logic.Threshold: Apply the unchanged frozen conventional threshold hysteresis without A_safe.
policy_logic.Unshielded-Q: Greedy argmax from the mapped frozen Unshielded-Q table over all actions; epsilon=0 and no update.
policy_logic.FSSQL-R: Greedy argmax from the mapped frozen FSSQL-R table over the exact same V2 A_safe used by Safe-Greedy; epsilon=0 and no update; frozen FISVDD fallback only if empty.

guard_lock.workload_specific_inputs: V2 n16/B0 latency and thermal predictions
guard_lock.unchanged_components: 40 ms and 82 C caps, V2 predictors, per-action residual margins, shared thermal margin, and fixed 10 ms/0.6 C buffers

q_learning.state_and_reward_lock: Use the frozen Q config without retraining. Energy-proxy state transitions and reward costs retain the frozen n1/B0 Q-training definition; n16/B0 changes the V2 guard and measured execution workload, not the learned objective.

execution_order.rule: Within each matched seed block, apply numpy.random.default_rng(base_seed + evaluation_seed).permutation to the six policies; execute seed blocks in ascending seed order.

start_and_cooldown.cooling: heatsink, continuously running fan, case top open
start_and_cooldown.power: corrected/replaced adapter and cable on stable wall-outlet path

invalid_if: any current undervoltage or throttle low-nibble bit
any per-window CPU frequency below 1350 MHz
missing, non-finite, incomplete, or semantically inconsistent required log fields
unrelated background job or unexpected process/I/O failure
invalid_attempt_rule: Retain the entire partial attempt and lineage. Stop the campaign; never stitch runs and never retry silently.

official_test.status_at_preregistration: already irrevocably opened for Formal Matrix V1
official_test.label_access_boundary: labels are separate and used only after selected-action inference
official_test.post_open_rule: No model, guard, workload, threshold, reward, state-bin, Q-learning, policy, seed, order, or trace change based on Formal Matrix V1 or Stress Extension V3 outcomes.
